audience: developers who send in-app, email and push notifications with MagicBell

useCases.title: Review the latest notification broadcasts
useCases.text: The AI lists broadcasts (batches of notification sends) and opens single ones. You get a summary of what was sent recently.

useCases.title: Check notification delivery events
useCases.text: The AI lists delivery events and opens single ones to see what happened to a notification.

useCases.title: Check how your workflows ran
useCases.text: The AI lists workflows and their runs (execution history), and opens a single run for its details.

useCases.title: See which channels and integrations are set up
useCases.text: The AI lists delivery channels (in-app, email, push, SMS) and the provider integrations, for example Sendgrid, APNs or FCM.

useCases.title: Look up, add or update a recipient
useCases.text: The AI finds a user by MagicBell id or external id, creates a user record from an external id or email, or updates one. It sends no notification.
